subject: English
passage: Museum curators report that more than half of all contemporary art installations credited to a famous artist or collective are in fact created by studio assistants, professional craftspeople who are paid to produce other ______ but whose names never appear on gallery placards.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The convention being tested is the use of plural and possessive nouns. The plural possessive noun "artists'" and the plural noun "works" correctly indicate that there are multiple works from multiple artists.
